beats.title: Through the Hidden Tunnel
beats.boundaryReason: The locked gate and ascent form one continuous journey to the upper storeroom. The next beat begins when Wellby rejoins the party.
dateEvidence: Session YAML anchors April 12; u0405 and u0868 establish late afternoon during this continuous opening exploration.

beats.title: Wellby’s Scouting Report
beats.boundaryReason: Wellby returns and recounts the old occupation and present activity; the next beat shifts to deciding where to scout.
dateEvidence: The same uninterrupted afternoon; u0377 says only about six hours have elapsed since leaving the horses, and u0405 identifies late afternoon.

beats.title: Mapping the Way Forward
beats.boundaryReason: The party debates routes, the iron construct, and splitting up; movement heard at u0674 interrupts the planning.
dateEvidence: u0405 identifies late afternoon. No rest or day transition occurs during the map discussion.

beats.title: Delwath Scouts Invisibly
beats.boundaryReason: A noise prompts Delwath to scout the prison and both ends of the curving tunnel; his return ends the reconnaissance.
dateEvidence: u0868 explicitly places the plaza in late-afternoon sun; u0854–u0859 give three or four minutes at the northern exit and u0961–u0962 about fifteen minutes for the complete scouting trip.

beats.title: Clearing the Undead Prison
beats.boundaryReason: The party plans and executes a quiet attack on the two undead, then examines the former prison before choosing lookout positions.
dateEvidence: Continuous same-day action following the late-afternoon scouting; the watch that follows begins in late afternoon at u1439–u1441.

beats.title: An Hour on Watch
beats.boundaryReason: The group selects and occupies two observation points for a shared short rest, then regroups at sunset.
dateEvidence: u1439–u1441 start an hour-long watch in late afternoon; u1459–u1462 end it at sunset/twilight. The southern account u1463–u1476 describes the same hour.

beats.title: The Empty Tower
beats.boundaryReason: Kenzo scouts the first tower under Invisibility, brings the party inside, and they search its abandoned rooms; the next beat enters the occupied tower.
dateEvidence: u1568 and u1620 say it is getting dark after the hour-long watch; there is no overnight transition.

beats.title: Finding Vola
beats.boundaryReason: Kenzo discovers the occupied tower and its prisoner, aids Vola, and returns to plan her rescue. The next beat begins the group’s approach.
dateEvidence: Same evening after the sunset watch; u1853–u1854 place Kenzo twenty minutes into his invisible scouting. The guard’s promise of more in the morning is future, not elapsed time.

beats.title: Fighting the Tower Guards
beats.boundaryReason: The rescue attempt starts with Sleep and becomes a fight with the orc and shapeshifter, ending when Kenzo kills the fleeing orc.
dateEvidence: Continuous rescue action on the same evening; u2075–u2076 leave about ten minutes on Kenzo’s hour-long Invisibility, and combat rounds at u2450–u2453 last seconds.

beats.title: Freeing Vola and Withdrawing
beats.boundaryReason: The party secures the remaining guard, recovers Vola’s equipment, and withdraws with her to the first tower; the next beat is their conversation in safety.
dateEvidence: Direct aftermath of the fight, with no rest or day change; u2850 later confirms about 7 p.m.

beats.title: Agata and the Relic Race
beats.boundaryReason: The final conversation reveals Vola’s mission and Agata’s relic hunt, then ends with discussion of cooperation and further investigation.
dateEvidence: u2849–u2850 explicitly establish about 7 p.m.; u2871 proposes a rest, but no rest or next day is played before the session ends.
